In Re:- An application for bail under Section 483 of th  Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection  with Khatra P.S. Case No.06 of 2024 dated 11.01.2024  under Sections 363/365 of the Indian Penal Code, Sectio  of the POCSO Act and adding Section 376(2) of the India  Penal Code.
In the matter of : Biplab Lohar.

.... Petitioner  Mr. Soumik Ganguly,
 Ms. Trisha Rakshit.

...for the Petition  Mr. Madhusudan Sur, ld. A.P.P.,
 Md. Ezaz Akhtar.
...for the State.
Mr. Arkaprabho Roy.

....for the De-facto complaina  1.
Petitioner submits there was an intimate relationship between him and the victim.
Victim has already been examined.
He is in custody for 294 days.
Accordingly, he prays for bail.
2. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the bail prayer.
3. Learned Advocate for the victim submits there was an age difference between the parties.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
Minor victim has already been examined.
She deposed that she has married the petitioner.

5. In light of her deposition and as there is no chance of concluding the trial in the near future, we are inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Signed By : ALOK SETH High Court of Calcutta 12 th of November 2024 05:02:16 PM 6.
